Which event in the history of football in the UK took place in each of the following years?
Choose  $ \mathbf{SIX} $ answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-H, next to Questions 15-20.
Events in the history of football

15.1870 (15)............A. The introduction of pay for the players
16.1874 (16)............B. a change to the design of the goal
17.1875 (17)............C. the first use of lights for matches
18.1877 (18)............D. the Introduction of goalkeepers
19.1878 (19)............E. the first International match
20.1880 (20)............F. two changes to the rules of the game
G. the introduction of a fee for spectators
H. an agreement on the length of a game
